result.markdown: --- title: "[Graph.motif_census()]{.doc-object-name .doc-function .doc-label .doc-label-method}" body-classes: doc-api-page doc-py-api-page shift-heading-level-by: 0 toc-depth: 3 page-navigation: false html-table-processing: none --- ::: {.doc-subject} Count occurrences of all non-isomorphic connected subgraphs of a given size. ::: ::: {.doc-usage-source} Usage [Source](https://github.com/rich-iannone/edgecase/blob/main/python/edgecase/graph.py#L12767-L12832){target="_blank" rel="noopener"} ::: ::: {.doc-signature .doc-Kind.FUNCTION} ```python Graph.motif_census( size=3, return_dict=False, ) ``` ::: ::: {.doc-text} ![Motif census](/assets/graphs/motif-census.light.svg){.lightbox fig-alt="Left: the seven-node graph from the dominating set figures, a pendant 1, triangle 2, 3, 4, a bridge 4–5, and triangle 5, 6, 7. Right: the two connected three-node motifs with their counts: 2 triangles and 6 induced paths, where a path is a triangle with its third edge missing (dashed)." width="100%"} Enumerates every connected induced subgraph of `size=` nodes, classifies each by its isomorphism class, and returns the counts. This is the standard *motif census* used in network biology to characterize local connectivity patterns. ::: ## Parameters {.doc-parameters} ::: {.doc-definition-items} [size]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [int]{.doc-parameter-annotation} [=]{.doc-parameter-default-sep .op} [[3]{.dv}]{.doc-parameter-default} : Number of nodes in each motif. Must be 3 or 4. [return_dict]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [bool]{.doc-parameter-annotation} [=]{.doc-parameter-default-sep .op} [[False]{.va}]{.doc-parameter-default} : If `True`, return the census dictionary directly. Otherwise return `self` for method chaining. ::: ## Returns {.doc-returns} ::: {.doc-definition-items} [dict or Graph]{.doc-parameter-annotation} : A `{motif_class: count}` dictionary, or `self` for chaining. ::: ## Examples {.doc-examples} ::: {#597ddc17 .cell execution_count=1} ``` {.python .cell-code} import edgecase as ec g = ( ec.Graph() .add_node(label="A") .add_node(label="B") .add_node(label="C") .add_node(label="D") .add_edge(source="A", target="B") .add_edge(source="B", target="C") .add_edge(source="A", target="C") .add_edge(source="C", target="D") ) g.motif_census(size=3, return_dict=True) ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=1} ``` {'triangle': 1, 'path': 2} ``` ::: :::
